title: Old Money
text: The gated estates of Uptown remember their friends. Hold the zone and the cheques write themselves.

title: The Pulpit
text: Chapel Fields' revival tents seat thousands. Whoever holds the pulpit gets the collection plate and the amen.

title: Press Row
text: Every editor on Fleet Lane owes someone a favour. Tomorrow's front page reaches you tonight.

title: Dockworkers' Union
text: The Mills' union marches whether you asked or not. Their banner has your face on it now.

title: The Capital
text: Every corridor in the Ring leaks. Hold the ministries and the files find their way to your desk.

title: Broadcast Hill
text: Garrison Hill's towers decide who exists this news cycle. Spike a story; run a different one.

title: The Badlands
text: Nothing moves through the Sprawl without a toll. Your people lean on a rival's convoy.

title: Restless Streets
text: Old Town never wanted a ruler. Holding it means paying for the privilege, every single week.

title: The Docks
text: Harbourside's patronage machine never sleeps: a job, a favour, a vote. Seat a loyalist anywhere.
